Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills. Factory code names no specific departments or loops.

OWNED FILES (only these; the test file is new):
  factory/board.py
  templates/systemd/estate-board.service
  templates/department_daily.sh.template
  departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh
  tests/test_board_tabs.py

CONTEXT (owner directive, Ankit 2026-08-02): 'we need different tabs for each loop department, not the same one.' factory/board.py (read fully) renders one page from board-feed.ndjson with an optional --department filter. The feed carries loop-factory departments (dept_status/metrics/andon/approval/active_run) AND loop_status rows whose department is a timer GROUP (podcast, seo, finance, social, other...). Board Template v1's zone grammar is locked and must not change within a page.

BUILD a multi-page tabbed board:
1. factory/board.py gains a --site <dir> mode (mutually exclusive with --out): render_site(feed_path, out_dir, title=None) writes index.html (the estate overview — ALL departments/groups, exactly today's estate render) plus one <slug>.html per tab, where tabs = union of (a) departments appearing in dept_status/metrics/andon/approval/active_run rows and (b) groups appearing in loop_status rows; slug = lowercase name safe-chard ([a-z0-9-], others -> '-'). Each per-tab page = the existing single-department render (reuse render_html with department=<name>, title '<name> — Loop Board').
2. Tab NAVIGATION on every page (index included): a nav strip directly under the header — links 'Estate' + one per tab, alphabetical, current tab visually marked (font-weight + underline, using existing CSS variables; add a .tabs/.tab CSS block consistent with the design system: thin rule below, muted inactive links, ink active). Every page links to every other page by RELATIVE href (index.html, <slug>.html) so the directory is portable.
3. Per-tab pages must include that tab's loop_status roster and its andons (verify render_html's department filter keeps kinds whose department == the tab name — loop_status rows use group as department so this already aligns; fix if not).
4. templates/systemd/estate-board.service — replace the two single-page factory.board ExecStart lines with ONE site render: /usr/bin/python3 -m factory.board --feed estate/state/board-feed.ndjson --site estate/state/boards (keep timersense + boardfeed lines and the header comments).
5. templates/department_daily.sh.template AND departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh — replace their per-page factory.board render lines with the single --site render into "${REPO}/estate/state/boards" (keep timersense + boardfeed lines; touch NOTHING else in podcast_daily.sh).
6. Backward compat: --out single-page mode keeps working unchanged.

tests/test_board_tabs.py — at least 8 tests with fixture feeds: render_site writes index.html + one page per department and per loop group; slugging handles spaces/oddchars; every page contains the nav with relative links to index and all tabs; the current tab is marked (assert the active class/marker on its own page and not on others); a per-tab page contains ONLY its department's content (assert another department's unit/finding absent); per-tab page shows that group's loop_status units; index shows all; --out single-page mode still renders (regression); deterministic (two renders byte-identical).

VERIFY: 'python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 8 new 'def test_' functions, or the verify command failing.
